description: Valider que le stub ou le vrai module est utilisé, détectant les imports accidentels

def test_import_successful():
    """Verify that ExecutionEngine is imported from correct module."""
    assert ExecutionEngine.__module__.startswith(("tests", "src")), \
        f"ExecutionEngine imported from unexpected module: {ExecutionEngine.__module__}"
